title: The Tragedy of Tianqing
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng, with his remnant soul body burning the last strand of power, his cry pierced through a thousand li of clouds straight into Chen Ji's heart—the last bloodline of Tianqing Sect awaits his choice.

text.content: The Xuanwu Sect's vanguard surged like a black tide, iron hooves trampling the final formation rune outside Tianqing Sect. The sky was dyed blood-red, wails and clashing metal weaving a hellish symphony. Though Chen Ji was a thousand li away, the moment his heart's blood touched the jade slip, he saw it—the eyes that had never opened, behind Xuanwu Sect.

The first defense line collapsed within three hours. The Xuanwu Sect's Foundation Building disciples formed a battle array like a crushing mill, sweeping through. Tianqing Sect's outer disciples fell in swathes. Blood saturated the blue stone steps, corpses piling like mountains. Some wept, some cursed, but more fell in silence, their eyes holding no fear, only bitterness.

dialogue.content: "Retreat! All disciples immediately fall back to the Inner Sect!" Mo Xiansheng's voice exploded like thunder across the sky. His frail figure blocked before three Xuanwu Sect elders, his withered hands weaving frenzied, broken formation runes—that was the final barrier he wove with his lifespan.

text.content: "Old fool, with your half-body-in-the-grave appearance, you dare block Xuanwu Sect's edge?" The Xuanwu Sect's Grand Elder sneered, spiritual pressure from his body pressing down like a collapsing mountain. "Today I'll show you what true sect heritage means!" He raised his hand—the Xuanwu Sect's supreme technique, the True Waters Art, monstrous waves surging toward Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: No trace of fear appeared on Mo Xiansheng's aged face. Instead, he smiled, that smile carrying inexplicable relief: "Heritage? This old man has lived three hundred years. Today, I'll let you see what it means—to trade life for life!" His body began burning, the broken soul scattering like fireflies, yet before vanishing, erupted with world-shaking radiance.

text.content: In the Grand Tutor's mansion, Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, blood spurting from his mouth. His chest felt pierced by ten thousand swords. He pressed down on his heart with whitened knuckles. Every trace of Mo Xiansheng's pain transmitted through the Tianji Record's connection—that was his master burning his soul to buy him time!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji clenched his fists tight, nails deeply embedding in his palms, blood dripping. Mo Xiansheng's past teachings endlessly flashed through his mind: "In a chess game, the sacrificed piece is normal. But a true chess master never lets a sacrificed piece die in vain." He closed his eyes, the Tianji Record flipping rapidly in his mind. Among those blurry future visions, Tianqing Sect's mountain gate was burning.

text.content: On the battlefield, Mo Xiansheng's voice pierced the clouds: "Chen Ji! Where are you!" His consciousness was fading, yet he exhausted his final strength to transmit a piece of information into the Tianji Record Fragment—"The last bloodline of Tianqing Sect is in the Inner Sect Forbidden Grounds. That old thief Ling Yuan has long been secretly communicating with Xuanwu Sect. Be careful—" Before the two words "be careful" finished, his figure completely scattered into the void.

Meanwhile, deep within the Inner Sect, Ling Yuan the old Sect Master curled his lips into a cold, sinister smile. He stood with hands behind his back at the entrance of the Forbidden Grounds, watching the frantically fleeing disciples. A trace of ruthless sharpness flickered in his eyes, not easily noticed. "Dear disciples, no need to panic. This old man has already arranged formations here. Surely I can protect everyone's safety." His voice was gentle as spring breeze, yet it sent chills down everyone's spine.

Far away in the Grand Tutor's mansion, through the Tianji Record's resonance, Chen Ji clearly saw Ling Yuan's expression. His pupils sharply contracted—that was not shelter, but the神情 of a hunter waiting for prey to enter the net. Mo Xiansheng's dying warning exploded in his mind like thunder: He finally understood why the Tianji Record, when choosing him, had skipped over Ling Yuan—that old fox was a player in the game from the very beginning.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's sacrifice, Ling Yuan's betrayal, Tianqing Sect's blood and tears—all tore at Chen Ji's heart. He must make a choice.

choices.text: Depart immediately, rescue a thousand li away
choices.description: Regardless of the cost, immediately set out for Tianqing Sect, stop Ling Yuan's conspiracy, and save the last bloodline.
choices.visible_reward: Possibly save Tianqing Sect's last bloodline
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan and Xuanwu Sect are sure to have follow-up moves. This journey bodes ill

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly rose, killing intent in his eyes like substantial substance. Before the hidden guards outside the Grand Tutor's mansion could react, he had already vanished into the night as a shadow. Mo Xiansheng's sacrifice, his sect's misfortune—all this, he would end personally.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to continue gazing at the future, remotely control the situation, wait for the best counterattack timing.
choices.visible_cost: Tianqing Sect disciples may suffer more casualties
choices.visible_reward: Grasp the overall situation, avoid打草惊蛇
choices.risk_hint: May bear the reputation of standing by and not rescuing

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the surging killing intent in his heart, sitting cross-legged again. The Tianji Record slowly unfolded before his eyes, countless images flickering like a carousel. He was waiting—waiting for Ling Yuan to reveal more flaws, waiting for Xuanwu Sect to show greater ambitions. Only by enduring what ordinary people cannot endure can one accomplish what ordinary people cannot accomplish.

choices.text: Trade life for life, Heavenly Fate sacrifice
choices.description: Burn more Heavenly Fate Value, forcefully gaze at more future details, attempt to find the key to breaking the situation.
choices.risk_hint: Excessive Heavenly Fate consumption will attract Heavenly Dao's Eye attention

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, urging the Tianji Record. Blood seeped from the corners of his eyes. A blurry yet extremely clear image reflected in his mind—deep within the Forbidden Grounds, a seal was loosening, and beneath that seal lay a secret足以颠覆三宗格局.

At the entrance of the Forbidden Grounds, before Ling Yuan's "shelter" words finished, the three elders of Xuanwu Sect had already broken through Mo Xiansheng's final barrier, breaking through into the Inner Sect like a破竹之势. Ling Yuan's smile deepened. He slowly stepped back, as if everything was under his control.
"Ling Yuan! You traitor!" A Tianqing Sect Inner Disciple roared, his sword just thrust out, yet was casually deflected by Ling Yuan.

dialogue.content: "Traitor?" Ling Yuan chuckled. "This old man has lurked for three hundred years, waiting precisely for today. The Tianji Record chose that废物 instead of this old man. Since that's the case, let the world see what Tianqing Sect becomes without the Tianji Record!" He waved his sleeve, the pre-arranged formation runes suddenly lit up, trapping all Tianqing Sect disciples present within.

text.content: In the Grand Tutor's mansion, Chen Ji, through the Tianji Record's resonance, had a clear view of all this. His nails deeply embedded in his palms, blood dripping, yet he was oblivious. Ling Yuan's hypocritical face constantly magnified in his mind. Rage and killing intent nearly burst through the dam of reason—but he could not act rashly, could not fall into the trap.

At this moment, a weak yet resolute consciousness penetrated the barriers of time and space, directly crashing into Chen Ji's heart sea. It was Mo Xiansheng's final remnant soul, carrying scorching temperature, endless regret and expectation.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji... This old man... lost the bet..." Mo Xiansheng's voice came in fragments, every word seemingly exhausting all his strength. "But you... cannot lose... The last bloodline of Tianqing Sect... in the deepest part of the Forbidden Grounds... beneath the seal... That is the... last hope left by the Chen clan ancestors... This old man believes in you... surely you can... protect them well..." The voice grew weaker, until it completely scattered into the void.

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, tears silently sliding down. Mo Xiansheng truly was gone. The old man who had guarded him for years with a remnant soul, who taught him what a chess game and sacrifice meant—that master finally turned into the final wisp of light illuminating his path forward.

He slowly stood, wiped away tears. The vulnerability in his eyes flickered briefly, replaced by bone-deep coldness. Ling Yuan, Xuanwu Sect, Heavenly Dao's Eye—all accounts of those who dared harm his people, he would settle one by one. But now, he must make a choice: gallop through the night to Tianqing Sect, or endure and lay out plans while waiting for the right moment?

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng has passed. Tianqing Sect is in dire straits. Do you choose to walk this road of no return, or continue sharpening your fangs in the shadows?

choices.description: Cast aside all concerns, hurry to Tianqing Sect at the fastest speed, even if exposing one's identity is inevitable.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the advantage of disguise, may be surrounded and killed
choices.visible_reward: Kill the traitor personally, avenge the master
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan and Xuanwu Sect have joined hands, strength is vastly unequal

text.content: Chen Ji coldly smiled, his figure turning into a shooting star streaking across the sky. Ling Yuan old thief, Mo Xiansheng's blood debt—pay it with your life!

choices.text: A gentleman seeks revenge, ten years is not late
choices.description: Forcefully suppress the heart of revenge, continue planning in the dark, wait for the best moment to deliver a fatal blow.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, deeply burying the killing intent in his heart. Master, I remember. The name Ling Yuan, I will erase personally. But not now—now, this is the layout you traded your life for. I cannot let it be wasted.

choices.text: Use another's strength to strike, drive the tiger from the mountain
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to contact the Demonic Path Saintess Ye Qing, exchange the secret behind Xuanwu Sect for her assistance.
choices.visible_cost: Owe a favor to the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: Demonic Path's involvement may bring greater complications

text.content: Chen Ji took out a jet-black communication jade slip, carving an encrypted message into it. Those eyes behind Xuanwu Sect—Ye Qing should want to see them more than anyone. The enemy of my enemy is a friend—at least in killing Ling Yuan, their goals align.

At the same time, deep within Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds, Ling Yuan led the three elders of Xuanwu Sect slowly inward. In the阴暗的甬道中, his voice echoed: "Gentlemen, do not think this old man is a traitor. This old man merely follows Heavenly Dao. The Tianji Record chose a废物—this is Tianqing Sect's悲哀, also the three sects'耻辱."

In the Grand Tutor's mansion, Chen Ji had all these images clearly in view. The corner of his lips curled into a cold, icy arc. Follow Heavenly Dao? Ling Yuan, you are merely a piece toyed with in the palm of Heavenly Dao's Eye. You think you are arranging a game, but the moment you stepped into this chess game, the outcome was already sealed.
